title: Bad update
text:
This update moves the navigation bar from the bottom to the top of the screen. While this change doesn’t seem significant at first, after extended it quickly becomes cumbersome. Now it creates a large, wasted space at the bottom of the screen, which is dedicated to ads. Unfortunately, none of these ads utilize the allotted space effectively, resulting in a large, unused rectangle at the bottom of the screen and effectual moves all touch targets higher on the screen. 

Additionally, all the navigation controls are now located at the top of the screen, making it impossible to quickly switch between them with one hand, which is essential when holding a baby. This unnecessary change is a clear example of prioritizing form over function, and I will be looking for an app that is more user-friendly and not hostile to its users.

title: Awful UX/UI but still good to use
text:
The ability to track and monitor and update is a good thing to have for a baby/newborn. But nothing uniquely different with this one. It’s like they tried to reinvent the wheel of a “CRM” and how to log and use the app. Why?? The click through to log something is beyond terrible and the graphs are excel 101 level data visualizations. Save buttons have different functions and adjusting times for incorrect data is tedious and uncoordinated. 

The app checks the box as a log but it’s like they went out of the way to make it more difficult to click through than needed. The notes app in an iPhone would be easier with more functionality and you don’t need to teach yourself a whole new system just to log something.

title: It’s great but has frequent annoying glitches
text: I love this app for tracking my 6 week old’s feeding and sleeping habits, but unfortunately my biggest perk for this app is also incredibly buggy - the Lock Screen display. I loved that this app has the ability to pin the widget to my Lock Screen so I don’t have to unlock my phone and open the app to see when I last fed my baby. But after using this app for weeks, I’ve noticed that the Lock Screen widget is incredibly buggy and will not update to the most recent feeds/diaper changes/naps. Sometimes for example it will say I fed my baby 7 hours ago when I know I entered his most recent feed from 1 hour ago. But when you open the app, most of the time the most recent feed is there (most of the time, sometimes the app is bugged entirely and will not update in-app either!). I love the app but the annoying bugs make me want to just go back to using Huckleberry, which I really didn’t enjoy the layout/display of, but did not experience these types of glitches.

text:
This review is a forewarning to all up-and-coming parents—DO NOT to use this app. To do so is an exercise in frustration, and likely futility. We have sunk weeks of our time and don’t have the time nor energy to export our data, so we are screwed. 

The app is extremely unintuitive to use. It takes just as much time to log an activity as it does to do it. And  Why are you not able to type in the time? why do you have to use the scroll wheel? It takes forever. How come it is so difficult to edit a previous entry?

None of the Siri shortcuts are intuitive either. They’re also unable to be edited once they are set.

Avoid at all costs. 

- signed,
A tired dad
